project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler, localStorage persistence, PWA-enabled
build_system: Vite 8 with npm, manual chunks configured in vite.config.js
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment, setup in src/test/setup.js
verification_instructions: 1. Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run` - all tests must pass. 2. Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build` - must succeed without errors.
environment_constraints: Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running npm/npx commands. npm install requires --legacy-peer-deps due to peer dependency conflicts. No Docker daemon available in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: ESLint config with jsx-a11y and simple-import-sort plugins at warn level. Tests use custom render from src/test/utils.jsx wrapping with MemoryRouter + AppProvider.
key_patterns: Lazy-loaded pages in App.jsx, AppContext for global state with localStorage write-through, existing service worker in public/sw.js, existing PWA manifest, existing useOnlineStatus hook, existing OfflineBanner/InstallPrompt components, existing performanceBudget.js, existing manualChunks in vite.config.js, test files in __tests__ subdirectories alongside components
directory_structure: src/components/<domain>/ for domain components, src/pages/ for route pages, src/hooks/ for custom hooks, src/lib/ for utilities, src/context/ for React context, src/test/ for test setup/utils, public/ for static assets, tests/e2e/ for Playwright E2E tests
